rounds.text: The valuation is unsupported by intrinsic fundamentals, evidenced by a discounted cash flow model placing intrinsic value at Rs 57 per share against a market price of Rs 84.5, creating a negative margin of safety of 48.2% [E45, E46, E70]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF implies an earnings growth expectation of 8.4%, which exceeds the 3.0% assumed in the base case [E47]. Profitability metrics remain depressed, highlighted by a low three-year median return on equity of 5% and a low historical return on equity of 4.6% to 4.76% [E13, E28, E62, E69]. Balance sheet pressures are evident as borrowings increased to Rs 176 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 159 Cr previously, contributing to a low interest coverage ratio and negative free cash flow of Rs -3 Cr [E36, E39, E60]. Institutional participation has completely vanished, with foreign and domestic institutions holding 0.00% as of June 2026 after progressive declines [E42, E43]. Technical momentum is equally weak, with the stock trading below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages alongside a twelve-month price return of -19.0% [E50, E52, E71]. Conceded: the company demonstrates recent profit growth acceleration alongside an improved trailing twelve-month profit growth of 35% and positive cash conversion of 1.12x [E21, E34, E73].
